purpose: Independent PW-PERF-C-A01 review of the B01 rework; no approval or merge authorization
cleanup_owner: Implementer/review actor after A01; reassess delivery at expiry if review is still pending. Never merge this review ref. Local own worktrees/data are removed after verified remote delivery.

environment.filesystem: NTFS, E:; isolated venv and task-owned TEMP/TMP

finding.definition: Initial clean tool checkout becomes dirty due to its own writer lock/stage; comparing whole producer provenance incorrectly rejects first v2 derive or reuse.
finding.fix: Record authentic invocation-start producer; recheck actual render tool and source/target guards independently. No new gitignore/path exclusions; no v1 or qualified-producer change.

success_mapping.criterion: Initially clean Git checkout, bound inputs and output_root inside it; first selected/none derive publishes exact full output
Reuse and independent CLI verify preserve bytes and nanosecond mtimes, original producer retained
Real untracked data still produces dirty=true; own lock/stage does not change render identity
Source, target and codec change after stage creation blocks publication and retains foreign bytes
Actual loaded render byte change/replacement, profiles and changed outputs still blocked

B01-before.txt.source: prior_head plus the new clean-checkout regression only; original product code
B01-before.txt.result: Expected failure: both selected and none return tool_mismatch before first publication; exit 1, 1 test, 2 failing subtests, 5.579 s

T01-final-head.txt.result: Extended 14-test Windows run: 13 passed, one test failed only in symlink subtest due WinError 1314 (missing creation privilege); 102.088 s. Not claimed as a local pass.
T01-final-head.txt.ci_resolution: Same unchanged test passes under Linux in job 132783033111 on test_merge; selected/none B01 tests pass there as well.
T01-final-head.txt.command: python -m unittest [the 14 fully qualified test names printed in this original log] -v

measurement_reproduction: Use isolated Python 3.13.14/Pillow 12.3.0, NTFS, own TASK/temp. Place measure.py directly in TASK, product checkout at TASK/repo. PW3_MEASURE_REPO selects the measured checkout. No concurrent local test/benchmark.

Run measure.py prepare exactly once on product_head. It creates both WorkflowFixture cases and preserves before-finalize and before-export snapshots in TASK/measure-v2, with paths in config-v2.json. These same bytes are restored before every measured operation.

Control checkout at base plus exactly background_assets.py, background_contract.py, background_package.py, catalog_background.py, image_normalization.py and background_render.py from product_head. All measured source module hashes and source_diff are recorded in raw reports.

Run PW3_MEASURE_REPO=control python measure.py T00-controlled, then PW3_MEASURE_REPO=repo python measure.py T01-final. Copy/setup outside the timer; warm OS cache, no forced cache flush. No extra repeat was used.

Driver derives from prior review commit a49be9028ac4d28631784a1801854101490ebd17. Only temporary phase-loop variable renamed label to phase_label so operation now correctly reports finalizer/export/verify-export on both sides. No timing/counter logic changed.

check.py independently validates every delivered file hash, current product module hashes, raw counts/limits/times and output equality. Run from this review checkout with python review/pw-perf-c-b01/check.py.

Finalizer inputs/results/outputs are identical. Export payloads identical except inspection.json and its manifest binding. Offline report differences restricted to checked_at_utc and genuine tool provenance/module identity. No original bytes are rewritten.
limitations: Synthetic warm-cache Windows measurement only; no real catalog, graphical acceptance, browser or player startup.
Only Python allocation peaks measured; no native/Git RSS or physical-disk bytes. Nested inclusive phases are not additive.
T03 selected modules and final CI result are linked in PR; A01 remains independently required.
Full PR diff whitespace check reports a pre-existing blank EOF in background_render.py from the prior implementation. B01-only diff has no whitespace errors; unrelated render source left unchanged.
